nearest_text_before.text: Загранпаспорт для этого не нужен, но документы стоит проверить заранее. Взрослым понадобится российский паспорт, а детям — свидетельство о рождении со штампом или отметкой о гражданстве РФ.

image_reading: High aerial view of a large resort complex set in a densely forested mountain valley.
The buildings form the central focal point, with winding access roads, green slopes, and visible lift lines framing the destination.
analysis.article_context: This cover-like aerial view introduces the resort as the calm mountain destination reached by an alternative route through Sukhumi; it should convey that the journey still leads to the resort.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Even when air travel is disrupted, the journey can still lead calmly to the mountain resort.
structured_intent.primary_action: The aerial viewpoint advances toward the resort complex.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The resort complex is clearly centered and more prominent as the visible destination.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The resort remains a calm, accessible mountain destination throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, make one gentle forward aerial approach toward the central cluster of resort buildings. Keep the valley and surrounding slopes legible while the approach steadily establishes the resort as the arrival point; finish with the complex larger and clearly centered, with only natural residual drift.
models.positive_prompt: A smooth, restrained aerial push toward the central resort complex, following the valley into the mountains. The resort remains fully visible and settles as the clear, calm destination in the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for a measured aerial glide toward the resort complex, with the movement beginning immediately and continuing evenly. The focal target is the central buildings; nearby roads and slopes retain their spatial context. Near the end, ease into a stable view where the resort is visibly the destination.
models.positive_prompt: Gently glide forward from the aerial view toward the resort at the center of the mountain valley. Maintain a calm, continuous approach; end with the resort clearly centered as the destination.

models.scene_plan: For four seconds, perform one focused forward aerial movement aimed at the center of the resort. Keep the motion moderate and continuous, preserving the mountain setting; reach a clear final composition with the resort enlarged and centered near the end.
models.positive_prompt: A concise aerial glide forward toward the central resort buildings in the mountain valley. Keep the approach smooth and calm, ending with the resort visibly centered as the destination.
